title: 花旗ECM联席主管：AI热潮未退，2027年发行市场依然强劲
speaker: Unknown (Citi Global Co-Head of Equity Capital Markets)

segments.en: When we think about the recent volatility, it's I think easy to forget that the NASDAQ is still up double digits for the year at this point in time.
segments.zh: 谈到近期的市场波动，我们很容易忘记，纳斯达克今年至今仍上涨两位数。

segments.en: And so therefore I think a pause and a cautious pause was always likely at some point in time. I think you've seen this in previous strong runs as well.
segments.zh: 因此，我认为某个时点出现暂停、谨慎的暂停，始终是可能的。此前的强势行情中也出现过类似情况。

segments.en: We think the underlying fundamentals, the underlying requirement for capital, the underlying quality of companies remains incredibly strong.
segments.zh: 我们认为，底层基本面、对资本的底层需求、公司的底层质量依然非常强劲。

segments.en: And I would predict that 2027 will be a big issuance here as well. Is AI still going to be the leader that are driving along that?
segments.zh: 我预计2027年这里的发行规模也会很大。人工智能是否仍将是推动这一趋势的领头羊？

segments.en: Undoubtedly so. I think it has been pretty much the leader over the last easily 12, 15, 18 months.
segments.zh: 毫无疑问。过去至少12、15、18个月里，它基本上一直是领头羊。

segments.en: We're certainly going through a phase where people are being a little bit more choice conscious in terms of where they go. And I think in the last couple of weeks, you've seen a bunch of other sectors that actually perform quite well and receive investment.
segments.zh: 我们确实正处于一个阶段，人们在选择方向上更加谨慎。过去几周，你会看到其他一些板块表现相当不错，也获得了资金配置。

segments.en: But undoubtedly with respect to the amount of capital that's required here, the amount of focus that people have on the space.
segments.zh: 但毫无疑问，就这里所需的资本规模、人们对该领域的关注程度而言。

segments.en: People that have a long only perspective and are looking through a longer period of time, AI will continue to be the theme of our times.
segments.zh: 对于从长线视角、着眼更长期限的人来说，人工智能将继续是我们这个时代的主题。
